label: は (topic / contrast)
meaning: marks the topic; can contrast alternatives
note: Read は as わ when it is the topic particle. It does not always mark the grammatical subject.

label: が (subject)
meaning: marks a subject, including new or focused information
note: Also used with some predicates of ability, preference or perception; が can have other functions.

label: を (object / path)
meaning: marks a direct object; can also mark a route or point of departure
note: Read を as お. The following predicate determines the role.

label: に (target / time / location)
meaning: marks a target, recipient, time, location of existence, or result
note: These are dictionary-level functions; choose the intended role from context.

label: で (location / means)
meaning: marks where an action happens, or its means or material
note: Particle で is distinguished from the copula's linking form by morphology.

label: の (relation / nominalization)
meaning: links nouns; can turn a clause into a noun-like expression
note: Possession is one of several noun-linking relations. Sentence-final の needs contextual interpretation.

label: と (and / with / quotation)
meaning: links nouns, marks accompaniment, or introduces quoted content
note: Conditional と is another function; these functions are not automatically disambiguated.

label: も (also / even)
meaning: adds an item to a set; can emphasize an unexpected extent
note: The focused element depends on the attached expression.

label: へ (direction)
meaning: marks a direction or destination
note: Read the directional particle へ as え.

label: まで (endpoint)
meaning: marks an endpoint or limit; can mean even
note: An endpoint can be in space, time or a range of possibilities.

label: か (question / alternative)
meaning: marks a question or presents alternatives
note: Can also combine with question words to form indefinite expressions.

label: ね (shared understanding)
meaning: seeks agreement or shared understanding
note: Its tone and purpose depend on the conversation.

label: よ (informing / emphasis)
meaning: presents information with emphasis for the listener
note: Often signals information or an assertion the speaker wants the listener to notice.

label: ～という + noun
meaning: a noun called ...; introduces a name or description
regex: という(?=森|名前|人|こと|もの|話|所|場所)
note: Confirm that という introduces the following noun.

label: ～ている / ～でいる
meaning: an ongoing action or a resulting state
regex: (?:て|で)(?:いる|いた|いて|いない|います|いました)
note: The precise aspect depends on the verb and context.

label: ～ていく / ～でいく
meaning: movement away; a change or action continuing onward
note: Distinguish a directional auxiliary from a separate motion verb.

label: ～てくる / ～でくる
meaning: movement toward the speaker; a change emerging up to now
note: Read the surrounding verb to determine direction or change.

label: ～んだ / ～のだ
meaning: gives an explanation or adds explanatory emphasis
regex: (?:ん|の)(?:だ|です|だった|でしょ|だね|だよ)
note: Colloquial ん corresponds to explanatory の.

label: ～から (reason)
meaning: because ...; gives a reason
regex: (?:る|た|だ|い|ない|ます|です)から
note: Rule-based candidate: distinguish reason から from origin or starting point.

label: verb stem + ながら
meaning: while doing ...; two actions by the same subject
note: Check the preceding verb stem.

label: ～しか～ない
meaning: only ...; nothing except ... (used with a negative)
note: The negative is part of the construction.

label: ～てもらう / ～でもらう
meaning: receive the benefit of someone doing something
regex: (?:て|で)もら(?:う|った|って|える|いたい)
note: The recipient presents the action as a benefit.

label: ～たばかり
meaning: have just done ...
note: Recently completed from the speaker's perspective.

label: ～ように / ～ような
meaning: like ...; as if ...; in such a way that ...
note: Similarity, manner, purpose and change require contextual review.

label: ～たら / ～だら
meaning: if / when ...
regex: (?:った|いた|えた|した|れた|んだ|かった)ら
note: Rule-based candidate: confirm the conditional conjugation.

label: ～ないで
meaning: without doing ...; please do not ...
note: Distinguish manner from a request using context.

label: ～てあげる / ～であげる
meaning: do something for someone
note: Marks an action presented as benefiting someone else.

label: ～にとって
meaning: for ...; from the standpoint of ...
note: Introduces the standpoint for an evaluation.

label: ～より (comparison)
meaning: than ...; compared with ...
note: Candidate: より can also mark an origin.

label: ～かもしれない
meaning: may / might ...; expresses uncertainty
regex: かもしれ(?:ない|なかった|ません)
note: A possibility rather than a definite statement.

label: ～てしまう / ～でしまう
meaning: complete something; sometimes regret or an unintended result
note: Completion and emotional implications depend on context.

label: ～ておく / ～でおく
meaning: do in preparation; leave in a state
note: The action prepares for something or preserves a result.

label: ～てみる / ～でみる
meaning: try doing something
note: Trying an action to see its result.

label: ～てくれる / ～でくれる
meaning: someone does something for the speaker or their group
note: The benefit is viewed from the speaker's side.

label: ～なくても
meaning: even if not ...; need not ... when followed by いい
note: Negative concessive form.

label: ～ても / ～でも
meaning: even if ...; even though ...
note: Candidate: check for the concessive verb form.

label: ～そう (appearance)
meaning: looks / seems ...
regex: (?:し|い|な|れ|け|せ|た|み)そう(?:な|に|だ|です)
note: Appearance そう differs from hearsay そうだ.

label: ～らしい
meaning: apparently ...; seems ...; characteristic of ...
note: Evidence-based inference or typical qualities; context decides.

label: ～みたい
meaning: like ...; seems ... (informal)
note: May express resemblance or an inference.

label: volitional + とする
meaning: try to do ...; be about to do ...
note: An attempt or an imminent action.

label: ～ために
meaning: for ...; in order to ...
note: Purpose or benefit; causal ため requires a different reading.

label: ～のに
meaning: although ...; despite ...
note: Candidate: のに can also indicate purpose or use.

label: ～はず
meaning: should ...; expected to ...
note: An expectation based on reasoning or knowledge.

label: ～と思う
meaning: think that ...
regex: と思(?:う|った|って|います)
note: と marks the content of a thought.

label: ～と言う
meaning: say ...; と marks a quotation
regex: と言(?:う|った|って|います)
note: Direct or indirect quotation.

label: verb stem + たい
meaning: want to do ...
note: Detected from the auxiliary たい, not a substring inside a word.

label: verb/adjective stem + すぎる
meaning: do too much; be excessively ...
note: Check the preceding stem.

label: ～たり～たりする
meaning: do things such as ...; gives representative actions
note: Paired examples; the list is not exhaustive.

label: ～ほうがいい
meaning: it is better to ...
note: Advice or comparison, depending on the preceding form.

label: ～なければ
meaning: if not ...; obligation when followed by ならない / いけない
note: Check the continuation before interpreting as obligation.

label: ～ことができる
meaning: can do ...; be able to ...
regex: ことができ(?:る|た|ない|ます)
note: An explicit ability construction.
